scope: Untimed single-threaded System global-allocator wrapper. Counts successful calls and requested layout bytes for one native API call, after warmup. Logical live-byte peaks exclude allocator overhead, usable-size rounding, internal realloc overlap and process RSS. Inputs and caller-retained prior outputs are outside each measurement. Instrumented binaries are never used for throughput timing; compiler allocation elision can affect observed calls.

driver_archive.scope: Exact as-run Windows provenance driver; run from the repository root on a fresh workspace at the selected commit.

log_normalization: CRLF to LF and terminal empty separator removal only
